research: The archival abstract records Joh. and Katharina Rosenberg buying a cottage in St. Maximinien/Umstraße; it supplies no lineage, office, or link to a documented Rosenberg house. Hans Rosenberg occupies neighboring property on Maximinstraße in 1661.json, but the similar first name and street do not establish identity or kinship. Neither the Aachen group nor the Franconian family can be inferred from surname and geography alone; attribution remains unresolved. The archive’s guide identifies C 1 as Kempen’s municipal charter collection. The district’s historical map locates Umstraße in the old town of Kempen. This gives the couple a more specific local setting and makes the 1661 neighbor a plausible match, but no evidence links this household to the medieval Aachen family or another listed family. https://kis.kreis-viersen.de/sdnetrim/UGhVM0hpd2NXNFdFcExjZXg2l21K1jgw3F6F6uSAtHnAsAD0KRljrrJEF1TsPoOzDEneBZpSmVK5ZdIEy1KSiA/Gesamtes_Sitzungspaket.pdf (p. 6), https://gars.nrw/images/user/GA_Viersen/richtwertkarten/Richtwertkarte_1978_Kreis_Viersen.pdf

entries.german:
Die Montagsspende verkauft an die Eheleute Joh. und Katharina Rosenberg das Püttlehnen-Häuschen in der St. Maximinien, vulgo Umstraße neben Cüsters Gielen und Heinr. Kruiken.

Schöffenbrief mit gewöhnlichem Siegel
entries.english:
The Monday donation sells to the married couple Joh. and Katharina Rosenberg the Püttlehnen cottage in St. Maximinien, commonly known as Umstraße, next to Cüster's Gielen and Heinr. Kruiken.

Schöffen letter (magistrate's deed) with ordinary seal
